propositions: transport.py has hit the 800-line cap four times in one day, forcing reactive rescue splits that do not change where new code naturally lands, perpetuating the cycle
the natural organizing seam already exists in _backend.py Protocols (TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsAbsenceProbe) which the class implements but the file layout ignores

re-architecting into capability-aligned mixins (_base, _issues, _hierarchy, _links, _people) with a thin composition root ensures every new operation has a determined home based on which capability it implements

the relocation must be mechanical with all tests passing unedited, JiraDataCenterTransport remaining a single class with Protocol conformance intact, and all split modules between 100–500 LOC to avoid both god files and fragmentation
_resolve_epic_link_field_id must have exactly one definition after the move to avoid reintroducing duplication that prior work (9bb9) deliberately avoided
the package docstring must document the organizing principle (one module per capability) so future operations default to the correct file rather than the remaining god file
